findingDetails.title: The Aside capture example session-dir containment guard does not normalize the path, so a traversal that leaves ./tmp passes a guard whose own message says it must stay under ./tmp
The Aside capture example accepts any URL scheme, so a file:// target is opened and screenshotted as evidence

results.summary: The npx -y bladebro criterion holds: every match names an operator yes and bladebro@4.8.2; browser-debugger-cli@alpha has no match
The Bladebro gate checklist rows hold; the Aside capture checklist row does not cover path containment or URL scheme

noveltyJustification: Both findings are new to the run and neither refines an earlier one: iteration 1 reviewed the advisor scorer, this iteration reviewed the install gate and the capture example, so weightedNew 6 of weightedTotal 6.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: 507 pre-bound files; this iteration narrowed to the two phase 014 fixes that touch a trust boundary plus the compiled policy card

targetSelection.selectionReason: The operator focus names the phase 014 fixes; the security dimension selects the two that cross a trust boundary, plus the compiled policy card the front door serves

searchLedger.hypothesis: The session-dir guard is a prefix glob, so a path that starts with ./tmp/ but resolves outside it passes
searchLedger.invariant: session-dir must stay under ./tmp in the REPL session folder
searchLedger.rationale: The guard message names the exact class it fails to reject, and the second layer is not proven to catch a .. traversal

searchLedger.hypothesis: The URL parameter accepts any scheme, so file:// and javascript: targets are opened and captured

searchActions.result: only a single quote and a backslash are rejected; no scheme check

searchLedger.rationale: An example other agents copy should not open local files through the signed-in browser

searchLedger.hypothesis: The install gate runs package code before the digest check, or fetches an unpinned version

searchActions.result: --ignore-scripts on the install, three verify_digest calls before the first --version, platform gate refuses any platform without a recorded digest

searchActions.queryOrPath: rg browser-debugger-cli@alpha in mcp-chrome-devtools excluding changelog and benchmark

searchLedger.rationale: The gate verifies before executing and every fetch is pinned
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: verified by direct read and by the packet own rg criterion

searchLedger.hypothesis: A replayed policy card can attest live activation or browser effects

searchActions.result: card stamped DOCUMENT_ONLY_UNATTESTED, replay returns PREPARED_DRAFT, parsePolicyCard throws on a missing payload

searchLedger.rationale: The card cannot claim live activation

title: The Aside capture example session-dir containment guard does not normalize the path, so a traversal that leaves ./tmp passes a guard whose own message says it must stay under ./tmp
The Aside capture example accepts any URL scheme, so a file:// target is opened and screenshotted as evidence

detail: security: one P1 path-containment guard gap and one P2 unvalidated URL scheme in the Aside capture example; the Bladebro install gate, the Chrome DevTools pin, the installer parity and the compiled policy card are clean

direction: The Bladebro install gate runs package code before the digest check
reason: --ignore-scripts is on the install and all three verify_digest calls precede the first --version

direction: The Chrome DevTools install is unpinned
reason: install.sh:30 pins browser-debugger-cli@0.6.10 and browser-debugger-cli@alpha has no match outside changelog and benchmark reports

direction: The installer parity fix is one-sided
The compiled policy card can attest live activation
reason: the card is stamped DOCUMENT_ONLY_UNATTESTED and replay returns PREPARED_DRAFT
